messages:
Maya Singh: Quick sync - Telco SI wants minute-level CDRs into Marketplace for their managed HW SKU. They expect same-day billing when events arrive within 6h. Need a short onboarding & recon plan.
Tom Reeves: I can own ingestion. Non-negotiables: HMAC sig, ISO ts with tz, replay_id, and an idempotency key. We should require tz_name for ambiguous DST hours.
Hannah Li: Ops asks: define late-arrival buckets: <=6h same-day, 6-48h next-period flagged, >48h manual adjustment. Also need entitlement mapping: IMSI->customer_id mapping from partner.
Priya Desai: Partner ops here. We can push minutely CDRs or 5m batches. We will provide daily entitlement CSV and a streaming ledger for recon.
Tom Reeves: Tech checklist: 1) contract signed 2) sig keys provisioned 3) staging replay 48h 4) canary 1% -> 10% -> full 5) recon job scheduled daily at 03:00 UTC for first 7 days.
Maya Singh: Rollback signals?
Hannah Li: Draft signals: 5xx rate >0.5% for 10m; ingest lag >120s for 10m; daily_recon_missing_pct >0.5%. Any -> revert to 15m batched mode + page SRE. Pin in channel.
Tom Reeves: Backfill policy: accept replay with header X-Telco-Replay-Id; ignore seen replay ids for 90 days; keep event hashes 7 days for realtime dedupe.
Priya Desai: Sending sample payload to staging now. We'll include tz_name and replay_id.
metering-bot: staging-smoke: 2025-05-12T02:00Z - 2100 events ingested, 0 sig fails, duplicates 0.2%, avg lag 28s
Maya Singh: Great. Tom/Hannah create the mini-playbook doc and I'll schedule the dry run with partner. Include the reconciliation script call (tools/telco_recon.sh) and the expected CSV columns in the doc.
Tom Reeves: Will do. I'll attach sample payload and HMAC header details in the doc.
Priya Desai: We'll be on the dry-run call Tue 02:00 UTC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
